name: Datopotamab deruxtecan
mechanism: Humanised anti-TROP2 IgG1 conjugated via a stable cleavable tetrapeptide linker to a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload (deruxtecan), with a bystander effect.
monitoring: Prophylactic steroid-containing mouthwash and oral care
Ophthalmological assessment and prophylactic lubricating eye drops
resistance: Mechanisms are under investigation, including TROP2 downregulation and payload resistance.
